page.layout: One column of names, ruled like a chronicle table, with the years in the left margin and short entries in the right margin. Printed page number at the head centre. No running head. Gathering signature at the foot centre.

l.note: Tumultus in Fivelgonia ab sacerdotium Farm-sumanum,

page.notes: The "_" after "Remian" and the mark after "Gelmar" look like a stray dash or flourish, not a letter; kept as printed. "Fivelgonia" and "sacerdotium" are printed as shown (likely errors for Frisia/sacerdotium forms, left unchanged). The signature "§ 3" at the foot is uncertain: the mark may be a different letter. The rows for 1271, 1273–1275 and 1277 and 1279 are blank in the text block, so their years are shown only as margin notes.
